export type AsyncApplicationMethods<Application> = {
    [Method in keyof Application]: Application[Method] extends (...args: infer Args) => infer Result ? (...args: Args) => Promise<Awaited<Result>> : never;
};

export interface HostCapabilityCallOptions {
    query_only?: true;
    signal?: AbortSignal;
    before_effect?: () => void | Promise<void>;
    assert_authority_current?: () => void;
}

export interface HostCapabilityDescriptor {
    capability_id: string;
    version: number;
    operation: HostCapabilityOperation;
    readonly action?: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/actions").ActionMetadata;
    readonly action_provider?: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/actions").ActionProvider;
}

export interface HostCapabilityInvocation extends ActionCallOrigin {
    readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
    readonly plugin?: HostPluginCaller;
    readonly consumer?: "plugin";
    beforeEffect(): Promise<void>;
    assertAuthorityCurrent(): void;
}

export type HostCapabilityOperation = "query" | "command";

export interface HostPluginCaller {
    readonly plugin_id: string;
    readonly install_id: string;
    readonly actor_id: string;
    readonly project_id: string | null;
    readonly declaration: Pick<import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/plugin").PluginDefinition, "manifest" | "agent_prompts" | "agent_skills">;
    readonly assertActive: () => void;
}

export interface LocalHostProjectClient {
    readonly host_instance_id: string;
    readonly project: LocalHostProjectReference;
    availability(capability: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/actions").ActionReference, options?: {
        readonly consumer?: "plugin";
    }): import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/actions").ActionAvailability;
    withScope<Result>(operation: (client: LocalHostProjectClient) => Result | Promise<Result>): Promise<Result>;
    invoke<Input, Output>(capability: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/actions").ActionDefinition<Input, Output>, input: Input, options?: HostCapabilityCallOptions): Promise<Output>;
}

}
